what_happened.line: The committee discussed the stalled turf field replacement, and the superintendent and athletic director will bring a plan for where fall teams practice and play by the next meeting.
The town wants agreements in place, including one with the parks department, before it commits money to the turf replacement.
The committee heard that the police chief requested a radio repeater system in the new building, and the building committee is weighing its cost and a possible change order.
The committee reviewed draft FY17 superintendent goals, and the superintendent will add language making clear that classroom visits cover each building.
No votes were taken; the only motion was to adjourn.

why_it_matters: Displaced fall teams could mean added transportation costs, and it is unclear whether they would fall on the athletics revolving fund or on the town budget, mostly taxes.
A change order for the radio repeater in the new building would add to the project's cost, which taxpayers carry.
